entry.title: a small guide to rate limiting
entry.content:
Short post: rate limiting is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Rate limiting shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
